content_sections.body:
Mai: Hello! I am Mai. What is your name?
Ben: Hi, Mai. My name is Ben.
Mai: Nice to meet you.
Ben: Nice to meet you, too. Goodbye!
content_sections.title: First greetings

content_sections.body: Use Hello or Hi to begin. Say I am + name or My name is + name. Ask What is your name? End with Goodbye. In speech, I am can become I'm.
content_sections.title: Say your name

exercises.prompt: Put the lines in a natural order.
Give a three-line introduction: greet, say your name, and close politely.
exercises.rubric: Uses an appropriate greeting.; Uses I am or My name is with a name.; Uses Nice to meet you or Goodbye to close.

objectives: Use hello, hi, and goodbye in short exchanges.
Say and ask a person's name with I am, My name is, and What is your name?

constraints: Use only names and greeting language from this lesson.
Do not use external audio or text.
listening.goal: Practise the listening target for this lesson.
listening.instruction: Read one original two-line greeting aloud at a slow A1 pace. Keep the text hidden until the learner answers: What is the speaker's name? Ask only that question, then reveal the lines and give brief feedback.

constraints: If no learner audio is available, provide a model only and state NOT_ASSESSED.
Do not infer pronunciation quality from typed text.
pronunciation.goal: Practise the pronunciation target for this lesson.
pronunciation.instruction: Model hello, hi, and my name is in short chunks. Ask the learner to repeat each chunk, focusing on a clear first sound in hello and natural stress on name.

constraints: Use no more than three short tutor turns.
Correct only the target greeting and name forms.
speaking.goal: Practise the speaking target for this lesson.
speaking.instruction: Act as a new classmate. Say hello and ask the learner's name. Wait for one answer, respond Nice to meet you, and invite the learner to say goodbye.

constraints: Do not write the full response for the learner.
Accept either I am or My name is.
writing.goal: Practise the writing target for this lesson.
writing.instruction: Ask the learner to write a three-line greeting with a name. Wait for the draft, then point out at most two target-language changes and ask for a revision.

title: Hello! My Name Is Mai
